title: Bunk on Joe Oliver and the tune Please
summary: Bunk said nothing notable on Oliver; Blumberg recalls Please as one of Bunk's most lyrical tunes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Did, uh, did Bunk ever talk about Joe Oliver or anything that you can remember?
Uh, I, not that I can remember, no, uh, I think Bunk mentioned him on the talking record, but, uh,
I think, I mean, I think that he just said the same thing, yeah, Oliver was a wonderful trumpet player, or something like that, but, uh, Aside from that, nothing. Nothing.
I don't know. That tune, Please, I never did hear him play that myself.
I remember that very well. That was one of my favorites of his, because he played it so lyrically, one of the most lyrical things he did.
He played very often there at the Sybison?
I think he played it fairly often. I think it was a favorite of his.
